Richie Kohler and Evan Kovacs investigate the WWII sinking of U-Boat 85 near Scotland. Could it have been attacked by a mysterious sea-creature?

Dressed To Kill. The team look for the most impressive and advanced uniforms of WW2, exploring the vital role of clothing and kit in gaining an advantage against the enemy. S1, Ep4
